## Body

PR #245: a pending acknowledgement must identify an executable action, not merely the same seat. Coalesce only the same closer and process/pane; otherwise explicitly refuse with a reason and deadline. Never weaken the original task's authority/incarnation brakes to satisfy a repeat request.

Compose transition tests: hold close by A, reparent to B or revive, request close again, assert refusal, let the old task skip, then retry and assert closure. Checking reparenting and repeat closes separately missed the lost-close bug. Check pending before note/holdings shortcuts, and release its guard before awaiting late admission.

R245-001 closed in the final review at `d43be5c79bc58cfbec035a4ba7cbdd8ab24a2615`. Successful CI artifact `14483955866` confirms `memory_turn_http` 22/22. PASS verdict: `7ac15533fdca9c61a879730ecbe8bbd8430720eb`. No local builds/tests ran.
